summary: Agent Recharge validation rules (max ₹3,00,000 + UTR=12-digit) fully tested on both backend and frontend. 15/15 backend pytest cases passed. Frontend UX verified end-to-end including E2E submission. Distributor withdrawal P0 regression check passed.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py POST /api/agent/recharges (lines 655-691): validation order is well-structured — amount>0 → amount<=300000 → utr strip → utr non-empty → utr.isdigit() → utr len==12. Embedded-spaces case correctly falls into 'must contain only digits' branch (since after strip, the inner spaces remain non-digit chars). Confirmed exact error strings match spec.

Recharge.jsx (line 38): UTR onChange uses /\D/g + slice(0,12) which is paste-safe and handles all non-digit char cases on the frontend. Confirmed visually that pasting '1234 5678 9012' yields '123456789012'.

Recharge.jsx: 'amountTooHigh && amt !== 0' shows the — placeholder only for amt>0 invalid (>max). When amount=0, neither breakdown is shown — slightly inconsistent (spec says 'Net Credit preview shows — when amount is invalid (zero or above max)'). Currently 0 hides the entire panel rather than showing —. LOW priority; spec also says 'until amount is valid' implying disabled submit which is correct.

Backend approval endpoint returns only {'ok': true} without the full updated document — clients who call this expecting the row back must re-fetch. Minor inconsistency but not a regression — admin UI already re-fetches list.
